svg.aria-label: The whole periodic table, unshaded, with the heavy zigzag staircase and three cells ringed: vanadium in the fourth row far to the left of the staircase, labeled left of the staircase, metal; bromine in the fourth row to the right of it, labeled right, nonmetal; arsenic in the fourth row with the staircase running down its left side, labeled metalloid
svg.text: 57–71 and 89–103 are 30 more metals, usually printed in two extra rows; this drawing leaves them out.
V (23): left of the staircase → metal
Br (35): right of the staircase → nonmetal
As (33): the staircase runs down its side → metalloid
